observations: The first task produced one successful apply_edits effect on src/builtin.c and later delivered a confirmed current-source read of the same affected path.
The verification-bearing request was dispatched exactly once, returned HTTP 200 with known usage, and ended with finish_reason length after 2,048 output tokens.
The detector classified readiness only after response parsing, so it did not recognize that the failed response had already consumed the verification-bearing prompt.
No branch ran; H65 treatment quality and cost remain untested.
inference: Completion-readiness is a property of receipt-confirmed input delivery. A parseable assistant output is unnecessary when the confirming response is discarded and no tool effect is admitted. The detector must establish the shared boundary from the known receipt before response parsing failure escapes.

selected_successor.name: receipt-complete completion readiness
selected_successor.mechanism: Retain H65 unchanged, but repair its instrument so a known HTTP 200 length receipt can confirm delivery of the verification observation, discard the incomplete output with zero effects, and fork exact state for one paired review.

alternatives.name: effect-only readiness
alternatives.disposition: defer until H65 is measured with a valid detector

open_questions: Does repaired receipt-first detection yield at least six eligible pairs?
Does treatment reduce or preserve aggregate and paired tokens while improving Span-F1?
